Name: StarAmys Furniture Catalogue
Author: StarAmy
Description:
[size=4]An optional stand-alone catalogue for all of my furniture! Buy from Robin for 25k and then decorate to your heart's content. 

As some shop menus were getting very crowded (especially for FF packs that don't work with AT skins), all of my existing furniture mods are being updated so that you can toggle normal store listings on or off and choose which method of accessing furniture you'd prefer.

If the catalogue is installed, it will display content from the newest versions of:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Museum Furniture from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19035]Museum Valley[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4]Functional Inset Wall Shelves from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19035]Museum Valley[/url]﻿[/size]
[*][size=4]Seasonal and Holiday Furniture from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21666]Seasonal Valley[/url][/size]
[*][size=4]Fairytale Furniture from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17622]Fairytale Valley [/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][size=4]
And from these ports by the wonderful Ashrayne:
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24224]Museum Furniture[/url] (From Museum Valley)﻿ for Furniture Framework[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23699]Bar and Cafe Furniture[/url] (From Gourmet Valley - WIP unreleased) for Content Patcher and Alternative Textures[/size]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23281]Bakery Displays [/url](From Gourmet Valley - WIP unreleased) for Content Patcher and Furniture Display Framework[/size]
[/list][list]
[*][size=4][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25086]Bakery Displays ([/url]﻿From Gourmet Valley - WIP unreleased) for Furniture Framework[/size]
[/list][size=4]
More coming soon![/size]
[size=4]You do NOT need to have every file installed, and I will keep it updated it as new optional dependents are released. Any lovely mod authors helping me roll forward furniture packs can target this catalogue with the context tag [i]collection_staramy[/i].





[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/hwFAblA.png[/img]

[/size][size=4][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24998/]My Furniture Catalogue [/url]﻿- [/b]Optionally displays any of my content patcher or furniture framework furniture packs.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13076]Fish Tank Bubble Toggle[/url] - Disables all fish tank bubbles by default, and adds a bubbler object to add them back in. Great for terrariums!

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21666]Seasonal Valley[/url] - A full farm building set with seasonal variations and unique configurable window themes, furniture and decorations for a variety of seasons and holidays, cute companion visitors, costumes, and more![b]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21292]Island Valley[/url][/b] - Spruce up the island with reworked building skins, wallpapers, vibrant new critter skins, a new farmhouse map, and new tropical foraging opportunities.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19035]Museum Valley[/url] - A new museum-themed shed replacement map, display furniture, signs, decorated wallpapers, and more.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/edit/?id=17622&game_id=1303&step=details]Fairytale Valley[/url] - New magical steeds, carriages, companions, wallpapers, furniture, clothing, and decorations for the witch, wizard, elf, or fairy going about valley life.[/size][/size]

Downloads.Description: Adds one purchasable catalogue that can display any of my furniture sets.
